_comment: Max raw (uncompressed) bytes per manualChunks prefix from vite.config.ts. Prefix matches dist/assets/<prefix>-<hash>.js (and sub-chunks like tanstack-form). Seeded from a real `vite build` on 2026-07-25 with ~15% headroom. Raise deliberately when a chunk legitimately grows; a jump usually means an accidental eager import. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs (npm run budget:check).
_performance_note: The 100 KiB target applies to the Vite entry chunk. The current shared MUI/auth/i18n modulepreload graph is reported separately until the shell dependency split is implemented. PWA precache is bounded independently and must not contain lazy route JavaScript, except the student portal + quiz player static graph (school labs fetch it once, off-peak; byte budget 2.0 -> 2.45 MB on 2026-11-14). Entry budget raised 80 -> 115 on 2026-11-13: Vite 8.1.6 (rolldown 1.1) splits small shared shell modules out of the entry (79 -> 109 entries, same ~1.6 MB precache bytes, entry 288 -> 234 KB).
_chunking_note: 2026-11-13 student-bundle: vite.config.ts codeSplitting groups. `shell` = all app code the entry statically needs (was ~40 tiny chunks; `index` is now a ~1 KB bootstrap), `mui` covers mui (entry) + mui-lazy (MUI/icons shared by 2+ lazy routes), `react` split out of `dnd`. `virtual` now also holds @tanstack/virtual-core (moved out of the eager `tanstack` chunk).
